headline: Iron Ore Futures Slump Toward Lowest Monthly Close Since October 2022
summary: Singapore iron ore futures fell 0.1% to $91.25 a ton, on track for their lowest month-end close since October 2022, while Dalian Exchange contracts also traded lower.
why: Iron ore is the primary raw material for steelmaking, serving as a critical barometer for global manufacturing and Chinese construction demand.

impacts.name: Iron Ore
impacts.why: Prices dropped to $91.25 a ton on Singapore and Dalian exchanges, heading for multi-year month-end lows.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
